# ArkHimar

> ArkHimar is the professional portfolio and architecture consultancy of Emmanuel Ayobami Olaniyan in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Canonical pages

- [Architecture consultancy](https://www.arkhimar.com/): Architectural design, building plans, working drawings, planning documentation, renovations, interiors, visualisation and site consultation.
- [Multidisciplinary portfolio](https://www.arkhimar.com/portfolio): AI and business automation, full-stack development, architecture and graphic design.
- [AI and business automation](https://www.arkhimar.com/portfolio/automation)
